notes: «أبو معاوية، وعبد الرحمن المحاربي، ووكيع» are three co-transmitters in one level (rule 2), not three routes; the attached «و» is left out of the surfaces
«قال انتهيت إلى عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص» — Abd al-Rahman reports what Abdullah said, so Abdullah is the last link (rule 6); the Prophet is not a link
«أنشدك الله أنت سمعت هذا» is a question inside the report, not a link
The SWI flag (three or more routes) is read as one level of alternatives
